steps: Hold one kettlebell or dumbbell upright against your chest.
Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips, toes slightly out.
Sit your hips down and back, like sitting into a low chair.
Go as low as you can with your chest up.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Goblet_Squat.hands: Cup the weight with both hands under your chin, wrists straight.
Goblet_Squat.arms: Keep your elbows tucked in and pointing down.
Goblet_Squat.legs: Knees follow your toes; heels stay on the floor.
Goblet_Squat.back: Keep your chest up and your back straight, not rounded.
Goblet_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you go down, out as you stand.
Goblet_Squat.mistake: Letting your knees cave inward or your heels lift off the floor.

steps: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells up beside your chest.
Push the dumbbells straight up until your arms are long.
Lower them slowly back to the sides of your chest.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.hands: Palms face your feet, wrists straight and stacked over your elbows.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.arms: Elbows point out at a slight angle, not straight out to the sides.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.legs: Feet flat on the floor, a little wider than your hips.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.back: Head, upper back and bottom stay on the bench.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.mistake: Dropping the weights too fast and bouncing them at the bottom.

steps: Sit at the row machine with feet on the footplate, knees slightly bent.
Lean forward to grab the handle, then sit up tall.
Pull the handle to your lower belly, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Let your arms straighten slowly, keeping your back tall.
Seated_Cable_Rows.hands: Grip the handle firmly, wrists straight, palms facing each other.
Seated_Cable_Rows.arms: Keep your elbows close to your sides as you pull.
Seated_Cable_Rows.legs: Knees stay slightly bent, feet pressed on the footplate.
Seated_Cable_Rows.back: Sit tall with a straight back; do not rock back and forth.
Seated_Cable_Rows.breathe: Breathe out as you pull, in as you let go.
Seated_Cable_Rows.mistake: Swinging your body back to move the weight instead of using your back.

steps: Sit on a bench with back support, a dumbbell in each hand.
Lift the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Push them straight up until your arms are long.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder height.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.hands: Palms face forward, wrists straight above your elbows.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.arms: Elbows start just below your hands and a little in front of you.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.legs: Feet flat on the floor for balance.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.back: Keep your back against the pad; do not arch.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you push up, in as you lower.
Dumbbell_Shoulder_Press.mistake: Arching your lower back to push the weight up.

steps: Lie face down, then rest on your forearms and toes.
Lift your body so it makes one straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your belly and bottom to stay straight.
Hold still and keep breathing.
Plank.hands: Hands flat or in loose fists, a little apart.
Plank.arms: Elbows sit right under your shoulders.
Plank.legs: Legs straight, feet about hip-width apart.
Plank.back: Back flat like a table; hips do not sag or poke up.
Plank.breathe: Breathe slowly and steadily. Do not hold your breath.
Plank.mistake: Letting your hips sag toward the floor.

steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees a little.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Push your hips forward to stand back up.
Romanian_Deadlift.hands: Grip the bar just wider than your hips, palms facing you.
Romanian_Deadlift.arms: Arms hang straight; they just hold the bar.
Romanian_Deadlift.legs: Knees slightly bent and stay the same the whole time.
Romanian_Deadlift.back: Keep your back flat and your chest proud. Never round it.
Romanian_Deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you stand up.
Romanian_Deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back to reach the bar lower.

steps: Set a bench to a slight incline and sit with dumbbells on your thighs.
Lie back and bring the dumbbells up beside your upper chest.
Push the dumbbells up until your arms are long.
Lower them slowly back to your upper chest.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.hands: Palms face forward, wrists straight over your elbows.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbows angle slightly down and out, not flared wide.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.back: Head, upper back and bottom stay on the bench.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.mistake: Setting the bench too steep so your shoulders do all the work.

steps: Sit at the machine with your thighs under the pad.
Grab the bar wider than your shoulders.
Lean back a little and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.hands: Palms face forward, hands wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.arms: Pull your elbows down toward your sides.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.legs: Thighs snug under the pad, feet flat.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.back: Chest up, slight lean back, no swinging.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down, in as you let up.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.mistake: Pulling the bar behind your neck or swinging your body.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by your sides.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front heel to step back.
Switch legs.
Dumbbell_Lunges.hands: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Dumbbell_Lunges.legs: Front knee stays over your ankle, not past your toes.
Dumbbell_Lunges.back: Keep your body upright, chest up.
Dumbbell_Lunges.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push back.
Dumbbell_Lunges.mistake: Letting the front knee wobble inward.

steps: Lie on your back with arms pointing up to the ceiling.
Lift your knees so they are bent over your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly straighten one leg and reach the opposite arm back.
Bring them back and switch sides.
Dead_Bug.arms: Arms start straight up, over your shoulders.
Dead_Bug.legs: Knees bent at a right angle, over your hips.
Dead_Bug.back: Lower back stays pressed to the floor the whole time.
Dead_Bug.breathe: Breathe out as you reach, in as you come back.
Dead_Bug.mistake: Letting your lower back arch off the floor.

steps: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off.
Lower the bar slowly to the middle of your chest.
Push it back up until your arms are straight.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders, wrists straight, not bent back.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.arms: Elbows point slightly down, not flared straight out.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.legs: Feet flat on the floor, pressing down.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.back: Shoulder blades squeezed together; head and bottom stay on the bench.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Barbell_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Grip.mistake: Bouncing the bar off your chest.

steps: Hold a barbell at your collarbone, standing with feet hip-width apart.
Tighten your belly and bottom.
Push the bar straight up over your head.
Lower it slowly back to your collarbone.
Standing_Military_Press.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Standing_Military_Press.arms: Elbows start under the bar and finish straight overhead.
Standing_Military_Press.legs: Legs straight but not locked, feet hip-width apart.
Standing_Military_Press.back: Stand tall; do not lean back.
Standing_Military_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.
Standing_Military_Press.mistake: Leaning back and arching your lower back.

steps: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders.
Pause for a moment.
Lower them slowly back down.
Side_Lateral_Raise.hands: Palms face down at the top, wrists straight.
Side_Lateral_Raise.arms: Keep a small bend in your elbows.
Side_Lateral_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Side_Lateral_Raise.mistake: Swinging your body to throw the weights up.

steps: Stand facing a high cable with a bar attached.
Hold the bar with your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it come back up slowly to about chest height.
Triceps_Pushdown.hands: Palms face down, hands about shoulder-width apart, wrists straight.
Triceps_Pushdown.arms: Upper arms stay still by your sides; only forearms move.
Triceps_Pushdown.back: Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Triceps_Pushdown.breathe: Breathe out as you push down, in as you let up.
Triceps_Pushdown.mistake: Letting your elbows drift forward away from your body.

steps: Set both pulleys high and hold one handle in each hand.
Step forward and lean your body forward a little.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide hug.
Open your arms slowly back out to the sides.
Cable_Crossover.hands: Hold the handles firmly, palms facing down and in.
Cable_Crossover.arms: Keep a soft bend in your elbows the whole time.
Cable_Crossover.legs: One foot in front of the other for balance.
Cable_Crossover.breathe: Breathe out as you bring your hands together.
Cable_Crossover.mistake: Bending and straightening your elbows like a press.

steps: Stand with your feet under the bar, hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and lift your chest.
Push through your feet and stand up tall with the bar.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back, then bending your knees.
Barbell_Deadlift.hands: Grip just outside your knees, palms facing you.
Barbell_Deadlift.arms: Arms stay straight; they only hold the bar.
Barbell_Deadlift.legs: Shins close to the bar, knees over your toes.
Barbell_Deadlift.back: Keep your back flat from start to finish.
Barbell_Deadlift.breathe: Take a big breath in before you lift.
Barbell_Deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back as you pull the bar off the floor.

steps: Hang from a bar with your palms facing away.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Pullups.hands: Grip a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Pullups.arms: Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Pullups.legs: Legs together, still, or crossed at the ankles.
Pullups.back: Chest lifts toward the bar; avoid swinging.
Pullups.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up, in as you lower.
Pullups.mistake: Kicking and swinging to get your chin over the bar.

steps: Hold a barbell and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend your knees a little and lean forward from your hips.
Let the bar hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders, palms facing down.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.arms: Elbows stay close to your body as you pull.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.back: Back flat and almost level with the floor; head in line.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.breathe: Breathe out as you pull, in as you lower.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row.mistake: Standing up and jerking the bar instead of staying bent over.

steps: Set a rope on a high cable and hold one end in each hand.
Step back so your arms are straight in front of you.
Pull the rope toward your face, spreading your hands apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let your arms go forward slowly.
Face_Pull.hands: Thumbs point back toward you as you pull.
Face_Pull.arms: Elbows stay high, about level with your shoulders.
Face_Pull.back: Stand tall; do not lean back to pull.
Face_Pull.breathe: Breathe out as you pull, in as you return.
Face_Pull.mistake: Letting your elbows drop down so it becomes a row.

steps: Stand tall holding a barbell, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.
Barbell_Curl.hands: Grip about shoulder-width apart, palms up, wrists straight.
Barbell_Curl.arms: Upper arms stay still; only your forearms move.
Barbell_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up, in as you lower.
Barbell_Curl.mistake: Swinging your body to lift the bar.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Turn your palms to face your legs.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly back down.
Hammer_Curls.hands: Palms face each other the whole time, like holding hammers.
Hammer_Curls.arms: Elbows stay by your sides and do not move forward.
Hammer_Curls.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.

steps: Set the bar on a rack just below shoulder height.
Step under it and rest it across your upper back.
Stand up, step back, and place feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back as low as you can with good form.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Barbell_Squat.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Barbell_Squat.arms: Elbows point down and slightly back.
Barbell_Squat.legs: Knees follow your toes; heels stay down.
Barbell_Squat.back: Chest up and back straight the whole time.
Barbell_Squat.breathe: Take a big breath before going down. Breathe out at the top.
Barbell_Squat.mistake: Letting your knees cave in or your chest drop forward.

steps: Sit in the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and straighten your legs.
Bend your knees slowly to lower the platform.
Push it back up without locking your knees.
Leg_Press.legs: Knees in line with your toes; do not lock them at the top.
Leg_Press.back: Lower back and bottom stay pressed into the seat.
Leg_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Leg_Press.mistake: Going so low that your bottom lifts off the seat.

steps: Lie face down on the machine with the pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles.
Curl your heels up toward your bottom.
Lower slowly until your legs are almost straight.
Lying_Leg_Curls.legs: Knees just off the edge of the bench.
Lying_Leg_Curls.back: Hips stay down on the bench.
Lying_Leg_Curls.breathe: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.
Lying_Leg_Curls.mistake: Lifting your hips off the bench to swing the weight.

steps: Sit on the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Hold the side handles.
Straighten your legs until they are almost locked.
Lower them slowly back down.
Leg_Extensions.hands: Hold the side handles to keep your body still.
Leg_Extensions.legs: Knees line up with the machine's pivot point.
Leg_Extensions.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Leg_Extensions.mistake: Kicking the weight up fast and letting it drop.

steps: Stand in the machine with the pads on your shoulders.
Put the balls of your feet on the step, heels hanging off.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.
Standing_Calf_Raises.hands: Hold the handles by your shoulders.
Standing_Calf_Raises.legs: Knees straight but soft, not locked.
Standing_Calf_Raises.breathe: Breathe out as you rise, in as you lower.
Standing_Calf_Raises.mistake: Bouncing quickly instead of moving slowly.

steps: Hang from a bar with your palms facing you.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Pull yourself up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Chin-Up.hands: Palms face you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Chin-Up.arms: Elbows stay close to your body.
Chin-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up, in as you lower.

steps: Lie on a bench holding a bar straight up over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just above your forehead.
Straighten your arms to push the bar back up.
Lying_Triceps_Press.hands: Grip about shoulder-width apart, palms facing up toward the ceiling.
Lying_Triceps_Press.arms: Upper arms stay still and point up; only forearms move.
Lying_Triceps_Press.back: Back and head flat on the bench.
Lying_Triceps_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Lying_Triceps_Press.mistake: Letting your elbows flare out to the sides.

steps: Stand in front of a sturdy box, a dumbbell in each hand.
Put your whole right foot on the box.
Push through your right heel to step up.
Step down slowly with your left foot, then your right.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups.hands: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups.legs: Front knee stays in line with your toes.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups.back: Stand tall; do not lean far forward.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups.breathe: Breathe out as you step up.
Dumbbell_Step_Ups.mistake: Pushing off the back foot instead of the front leg.

steps: Sit on the machine with the pad on your lower thighs.
Put the balls of your feet on the step, heels off.
Release the safety and lower your heels slowly.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Seated_Calf_Raise.hands: Rest your hands on the pad.
Seated_Calf_Raise.legs: Knees bent at about a right angle.
Seated_Calf_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you push up, in as you lower.
Seated_Calf_Raise.mistake: Rushing through tiny bounces instead of full, slow reps.

steps: Sit on a bench with back support.
Hold dumbbells at chest height, palms facing you.
Press up while turning your palms to face forward.
Lower and turn your palms back to face you.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.hands: Wrists stay straight as your palms turn.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbows start in front of you and open out as you press.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.back: Back against the pad; do not arch.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press.mistake: Rushing the twist so the weights wobble.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.arms: Upper arms stay still; only your forearms move.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you curl, in as you lower.
Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.mistake: Swinging your body to lift the weights.

steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench.
Roll a padded bar over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Lower your hips slowly.
Barbell_Hip_Thrust.hands: Hold the bar on your hips to keep it steady.
Barbell_Hip_Thrust.legs: At the top, shins are straight up and down.
Barbell_Hip_Thrust.back: Upper back rests on the bench; ribs stay down.
Barbell_Hip_Thrust.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Barbell_Hip_Thrust.mistake: Arching your lower back instead of squeezing your bottom.

steps: Stand in front of a bench, a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Bend your front knee and lower your body straight down.
Push through your front heel to come back up.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.hands: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.legs: Front knee follows your toes; back knee drops toward the floor.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.back: Body stays tall, with a slight lean forward.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Split_Squat_with_Dumbbells.mistake: Standing too close to the bench, so the front knee shoots forward.

steps: Strap a cuff to your ankle and attach it to a low cable.
Face the machine and hold the frame.
Kick your leg straight back, squeezing your bottom.
Bring it forward slowly.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.hands: Hold the machine frame for balance.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.legs: Standing knee soft; working leg moves back in a slow arc.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.back: Back stays still; do not arch to kick higher.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.breathe: Breathe out as you kick back.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback.mistake: Arching your lower back to lift the leg higher.

steps: Sit in the machine with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Hold the handles.
Push your legs apart.
Bring them back together slowly.
Thigh_Abductor.legs: Push with the outside of your thighs.
Thigh_Abductor.back: Sit tall against the pad; upper body stays still.
Thigh_Abductor.breathe: Breathe out as you push apart.
Thigh_Abductor.mistake: Letting the weight slam back between reps.

steps: Sit in the machine with the pads on the inside of your knees.
Hold the handles.
Squeeze your legs together.
Let them open slowly.
Thigh_Adductor.back: Sit tall against the pad; upper body stays still.
Thigh_Adductor.breathe: Breathe out as you squeeze together.
Thigh_Adductor.mistake: Jerking the legs together instead of moving smoothly.

steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, like sitting in a chair.
Go as low as is comfortable with your chest up.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Bodyweight_Squat.hands: Hold your hands together at your chest or reach them forward.
Bodyweight_Squat.legs: Knees follow your toes; heels stay on the floor.
Bodyweight_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you go down, out as you stand.

steps: Start on hands and toes, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
Make your body one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Push the floor away to come back up.
Pushups.hands: Hands flat under your shoulders, a little wider, fingers forward.
Pushups.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle, not straight out to the sides.
Pushups.back: Back flat; hips do not sag or pike up.
Pushups.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Pushups.mistake: Letting your hips sag toward the floor.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Put your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your bottom at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.hands: Palms flat on the floor by your sides.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.arms: Arms rest on the floor for balance.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.legs: Feet hip-width apart, knees pointing up.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.back: At the top, shoulders to knees make a straight line.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Butt_Lift_Bridge.mistake: Arching your lower back instead of lifting with your bottom.

steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your back knee until it nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front heel and step the back foot forward.
Keep walking forward, switching legs each step.
Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.hands: Rest your hands on your hips.
Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.legs: Front knee stays over your foot; back knee drops straight down.
Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
Bodyweight_Walking_Lunge.mistake: Taking tiny steps so the front knee pushes past your toes.

steps: Start in a push-up position on your hands and toes.
Bring one knee in toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, like running in place.
Keep going for the time set.
Mountain_Climbers.hands: Hands flat under your shoulders, fingers spread.
Mountain_Climbers.legs: Knees drive in toward your chest one at a time.
Mountain_Climbers.back: Back flat; keep your hips level with your shoulders.
Mountain_Climbers.breathe: Breathe quickly but steadily. Do not hold your breath.
Mountain_Climbers.mistake: Letting your hips bounce up high.

steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench.
Put your left foot on top and step up.
As you stand, lift your right knee up high.
Step back down the same way.
Switch legs.
Step-up_with_Knee_Raise.arms: Swing your arms like you are running.
Step-up_with_Knee_Raise.legs: Whole foot on the step; knee in line with your toes.
Step-up_with_Knee_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you step up.
Step-up_with_Knee_Raise.mistake: Pushing off the floor foot instead of the leg on the step.

steps: Place your hands on the edge of a sturdy desk, bench or table.
Walk your feet back until your body is one straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the edge.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Incline_Push-Up.hands: Hands a little wider than your shoulders, fingers forward.
Incline_Push-Up.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle, not straight out.
Incline_Push-Up.legs: Legs straight, up on your toes.
Incline_Push-Up.back: Back flat from head to heels; do not bend at the hips.
Incline_Push-Up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Incline_Push-Up.mistake: Using something that can slide or tip over.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift one foot and hold that knee toward your chest.
Push through the heel on the floor to lift your hips.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.hands: Palms flat on the floor, or holding the raised knee.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.legs: Working foot flat and close to your bottom.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.back: Hips stay level; do not let one side drop.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Single_Leg_Glute_Bridge.mistake: Letting your hips tilt to one side.

steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Have someone hold your legs down.
Cross your arms over your chest and let your body hang down.
Lift your upper body until it is in line with your legs.
Lower slowly.
Hyperextensions_With_No_Hyperextension_B.back: Lift only until your body is straight; do not arch past it.
Hyperextensions_With_No_Hyperextension_B.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Hyperextensions_With_No_Hyperextension_B.mistake: Swinging up fast and arching too far at the top.

steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and grip the edge beside your hips.
Slide your bottom off the bench, legs out in front.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Stop when your elbows are bent at about a right angle.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Bench_Dips.hands: Fingers point forward, hands right beside your hips.
Bench_Dips.arms: Elbows point straight back, not out to the sides.
Bench_Dips.legs: Bend your knees to make it easier; straighten them to make it harder.
Bench_Dips.back: Keep your back close to the bench.
Bench_Dips.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push up.
Bench_Dips.mistake: Going too low so your shoulders roll forward.

steps: Put your left knee and left hand on a bench.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand, arm straight down.
Pull the dumbbell up to the side of your ribs.
Lower it slowly until your arm is straight.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.hands: Palm faces your body, wrist straight.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.arms: Elbow stays close to your side as you pull.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.legs: Standing leg slightly bent, foot flat.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.back: Back flat and level with the floor; do not twist.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.breathe: Breathe out as you pull, in as you lower.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.mistake: Twisting your body to swing the weight up.

steps: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Let your hands come back slowly.
Band_Pull_Apart.hands: Palms face down, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Band_Pull_Apart.arms: Arms stay straight, with a tiny bend in the elbows.
Band_Pull_Apart.back: Stand tall; keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Band_Pull_Apart.breathe: Breathe out as you pull apart.
Band_Pull_Apart.mistake: Shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears.

steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Lift it straight up over your head.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.hands: Cup the top end of the dumbbell with both palms.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.arms: Elbows point up and stay close to your head.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.back: Stand tall; do not arch your back.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you lift.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.mistake: Letting your elbows flare out wide.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees a little.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Push your hips forward to stand tall.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.arms: Arms hang straight; the dumbbells stay close to your legs.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.legs: Knees slightly bent and stay that way.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you stand.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back to reach lower.

steps: Lie on your back with a band across your hips, fixed on both sides.
Bend your knees and put your feet flat.
Push through your heels to lift your hips into the band.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Hip_Lift_with_Band.hands: Hands on the floor or holding the band in place.
Hip_Lift_with_Band.legs: Feet hip-width apart, knees pointing up.
Hip_Lift_with_Band.back: Shoulders stay on the floor; do not arch at the top.
Hip_Lift_with_Band.mistake: Pushing with your lower back instead of your bottom.

steps: Hold on to something sturdy for balance.
Stand with the balls of one foot on a dumbbell handle.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly to feel a stretch in your calf.
Switch feet.
Calf_Raise_On_A_Dumbbell.hands: Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Calf_Raise_On_A_Dumbbell.mistake: Going too fast and losing balance.

steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet down.
Lean back a little until your belly works.
Hold your hands together in front of you.
Turn your shoulders to one side, then the other.
Russian_Twist.hands: Hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Russian_Twist.legs: Knees bent; feet on the floor or tucked under something.
Russian_Twist.breathe: Breathe out as you turn to each side.
Russian_Twist.mistake: Only moving your arms instead of turning your chest.

steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Jump straight up as high as you can.
Land softly and go straight into the next squat.
Freehand_Jump_Squat.arms: Cross your arms over your chest or swing them up.
Freehand_Jump_Squat.legs: Land on soft, bent knees that follow your toes.
Freehand_Jump_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you squat, out as you jump.

steps: Start in a lunge, one foot forward and both knees bent.
Jump up and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward.
Keep switching.
Scissors_Jump.arms: Swing your arms to help you jump.
Scissors_Jump.legs: Front knee over your foot when you land.
Scissors_Jump.mistake: Landing hard with a straight front leg.

steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as the other leg straightens.
Switch sides like pedaling a bike.
Air_Bike.hands: Fingertips lightly touch your head. Do not pull on your neck.
Air_Bike.arms: Elbows point out to the sides.
Air_Bike.legs: Pedal slowly; the straight leg stays off the floor.
Air_Bike.back: Lower back stays pressed to the floor.
Air_Bike.breathe: Breathe out each time you twist.
Air_Bike.mistake: Pulling your head forward with your hands.

steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge.
Hold the front of the bench.
Lift your legs until they are level with your hips.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick moves, like swimming.
Flutter_Kicks.hands: Hold the front edge of the bench.
Flutter_Kicks.back: Hips stay on the bench; do not over-arch.
Flutter_Kicks.mistake: Swinging your legs too high and arching your lower back.

steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Put your hands by your sides or under your bottom.
Bend your knees and pull them in toward your chest.
Straighten your legs back out slowly.
Leg_Pull-In.legs: Lower legs stay level with the floor as you pull in.
Leg_Pull-In.back: Lower back stays on the floor.
Leg_Pull-In.breathe: Breathe out as you pull in.
Leg_Pull-In.mistake: Letting your lower back arch as your legs go out.

steps: Sit or lie down comfortably.
Put one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose so your belly rises.
Breathe out slowly and feel your belly sink.
Diaphragmatic_Breathing.hands: One hand on your chest, one on your belly.
Diaphragmatic_Breathing.back: Lie flat or sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Diaphragmatic_Breathing.breathe: Make the breath out a little longer than the breath in.
Diaphragmatic_Breathing.mistake: Lifting your chest and shoulders instead of your belly.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, or sit up tall.
Squeeze the muscles you use to stop peeing.
Hold the squeeze and keep breathing.
Let go all the way and rest.
Kegel_Long_Hold.hands: Rest a hand on your belly to check it stays soft.
Kegel_Long_Hold.legs: Knees bent and relaxed. Do not squeeze your thighs.
Kegel_Long_Hold.back: Lie flat or sit tall. Keep your bottom relaxed.
Kegel_Long_Hold.breathe: Keep breathing slowly. Never hold your breath.
Kegel_Long_Hold.mistake: Squeezing your bottom or belly instead of the muscles down below.

steps: Lie down or sit in a comfy spot.
Squeeze the muscles you use to stop peeing, quickly.
Let go straight away.
Repeat with a steady beat.
Kegel_Quick_Flick.hands: Rest your hands on your belly or thighs.
Kegel_Quick_Flick.legs: Legs relaxed, knees bent if lying down.
Kegel_Quick_Flick.mistake: Not letting go fully between squeezes.

steps: Picture a lift going up three floors inside you.
Squeeze a little and pause. Squeeze more and pause.
Squeeze all the way to the top floor.
Let go one floor at a time, then relax fully.
Kegel_Elevator.hands: Rest your hands on your belly.
Kegel_Elevator.back: Lie flat or sit tall, relaxed.
Kegel_Elevator.breathe: Breathe gently all the way up and down.
Kegel_Elevator.mistake: Holding your breath while you squeeze.

steps: Lie or sit comfortably and let your belly go soft.
Breathe in slowly and let your belly fill up.
Let the muscles down below relax and drop.
Breathe out and let them settle. Do not squeeze.
Reverse_Kegel.hands: One hand on your belly to feel it rise.
Reverse_Kegel.legs: Legs relaxed and a little apart.
Reverse_Kegel.back: Back relaxed on the floor or chair.
Reverse_Kegel.breathe: Slow breath in through the nose; easy breath out.
Reverse_Kegel.mistake: Pushing hard, like straining, instead of gently letting go.

steps: Get on your hands and knees.
Pull your belly in and round your back up like a cat.
Let your head drop down.
Then let your belly sink and lift your head gently. Repeat slowly.
Cat_Stretch.hands: Hands flat under your shoulders, fingers spread.
Cat_Stretch.back: Move your whole back slowly from rounded to gently arched.
Cat_Stretch.breathe: Breathe out as you round up, in as you dip.
Cat_Stretch.mistake: Rushing through it instead of moving slowly.

steps: Start on your hands and knees.
Walk your hands forward a little.
Sit your bottom back toward your heels.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax.
Childs_Pose.hands: Arms long in front of you, or resting by your feet.
Childs_Pose.arms: Let your arms relax on the floor.
Childs_Pose.legs: Knees together or wide apart, whichever feels better.
Childs_Pose.back: Let your back round and relax.
Childs_Pose.mistake: Forcing your bottom down if your knees hurt. Use a pillow.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Tuck your tailbone up so your lower back flattens.
Keep lifting, one bit of your back at a time, into a bridge.
Lower slowly, one bit at a time.
Pelvic_Tilt_Into_Bridge.hands: Palms flat on the floor by your sides.
Pelvic_Tilt_Into_Bridge.back: Peel your spine up and down slowly, not all at once.
Pelvic_Tilt_Into_Bridge.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Pelvic_Tilt_Into_Bridge.mistake: Lifting your whole back at once like a plank.

steps: Lie on your back and loop a band or belt around one foot.
Keep that leg straight and swing it across your body.
Gently pull on the band until you feel a stretch.
Hold, then switch sides.
IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch.hands: Hold the band with the hand on the opposite side.
IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch.legs: Stretching leg straight; other leg rests on the floor.
IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch.back: Shoulders stay flat on the floor.
IT_Band_and_Glute_Stretch.mistake: Letting your shoulders lift off the floor.

steps: Stand facing a wall and put your hands on it.
Step one foot back.
Keep the back heel on the floor and lean into the wall.
Hold, then switch legs.
Calf_Stretch_Hands_Against_Wall.hands: Hands flat on the wall at shoulder height.
Calf_Stretch_Hands_Against_Wall.legs: Back leg straight, heel down; front knee bent.
Calf_Stretch_Hands_Against_Wall.back: Head, hips and back heel in one line.
Calf_Stretch_Hands_Against_Wall.mistake: Letting the back heel lift off the floor.

steps: Sit tall with your feet flat and shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tip your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Come back to the middle, then tip to the left.
Then lower your chin to your chest and lift it back up.
Desk_Neck_Tilt.hands: Rest your hands on your thighs.
Desk_Neck_Tilt.arms: Arms relaxed; let your shoulders drop.
Desk_Neck_Tilt.back: Sit tall; keep your back away from the chair.
Desk_Neck_Tilt.breathe: Breathe out as you tilt, in as you come back.
Desk_Neck_Tilt.mistake: Lifting your shoulder up to meet your ear.

steps: Sit or stand tall and look straight ahead.
Slide your chin straight back, making a double chin.
Hold for a moment.
Let go and repeat.
Desk_Chin_Tuck.hands: Rest your hands in your lap.
Desk_Chin_Tuck.back: Sit tall; your head moves back, not down.
Desk_Chin_Tuck.mistake: Tipping your head down instead of sliding it straight back.

steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms loose.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a slow circle.
After a few circles, roll the other way.
Shoulder_Circles.hands: Hands loose by your sides or resting in your lap.
Shoulder_Circles.arms: Arms relaxed; only your shoulders move.
Shoulder_Circles.breathe: Breathe in as shoulders rise, out as they drop.
Shoulder_Circles.mistake: Rushing through small circles instead of big, slow ones.

steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat.
Put your left hand on your right knee.
Put your right hand on the back of the chair.
Breathe out and gently turn to the right. Hold.
Come back slowly and switch sides.
Desk_Seated_Twist.hands: One hand on the opposite knee, the other on the chair back.
Desk_Seated_Twist.arms: Use your arms gently; do not yank yourself around.
Desk_Seated_Twist.legs: Knees face forward, feet flat on the floor.
Desk_Seated_Twist.back: Sit tall first, then twist. Do not slump.
Desk_Seated_Twist.breathe: Breathe in to sit tall, out to turn a bit more.
Desk_Seated_Twist.mistake: Slumping or forcing the twist with your arms.

steps: Hold your right arm out in front, palm facing away.
Gently pull your right fingers back toward you. Hold.
Turn your palm down and gently press the back of your hand toward you. Hold.
Make a fist, then spread your fingers wide.
Switch hands.
Desk_Wrist_Stretch.hands: Pull gently. You should feel a stretch, not pain.
Desk_Wrist_Stretch.arms: Keep your stretching arm straight at shoulder height.
Desk_Wrist_Stretch.back: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Desk_Wrist_Stretch.breathe: Breathe slowly as you hold each stretch.
Desk_Wrist_Stretch.mistake: Pulling too hard on your fingers.

steps: Look away from your screen.
Find something far away, about 20 feet (6 metres) or more.
Look at it softly for 20 seconds.
Blink a few times, then go back to work.
Eye_20_20_20.back: Sit back in your chair and let your shoulders drop.
Eye_20_20_20.breathe: Breathe slowly and let your face relax.
Eye_20_20_20.mistake: Looking at your phone instead of something far away.

steps: Sit back and rest your elbows on the desk.
Rub your palms together until they feel warm.
Close your eyes and cup your palms over them.
Breathe slowly and enjoy the dark.
Eye_Palming.hands: Cup your palms over your eyes. Do not press on them.
Eye_Palming.arms: Rest your elbows on the desk so your arms can relax.
Eye_Palming.back: Sit tall and lean slightly forward onto your elbows.
Eye_Palming.breathe: Breathe slowly in through your nose and out.

steps: Hold your thumb up at arm's length.
Look at your thumb until it is sharp.
Now look at something far away until it is sharp.
Switch slowly between near and far.
Eye_Near_Far_Focus.hands: Thumb up, about at eye level.
Eye_Near_Far_Focus.arms: Arm straight out in front of you.
Eye_Near_Far_Focus.back: Sit tall and keep your head still.
Eye_Near_Far_Focus.breathe: Breathe normally and blink when you need to.
Eye_Near_Far_Focus.mistake: Switching too fast before each view gets sharp.

steps: Sit back and relax your face.
Close your eyes gently, like falling asleep.
Pause with your eyes closed.
Open them slowly. Repeat.
Eye_Slow_Blinks.back: Sit back with your shoulders relaxed.
Eye_Slow_Blinks.breathe: Breathe in as you open, out as you close.

steps: Sit tall and let your shoulders drop.
Rest your tongue on the roof of your mouth, behind your top teeth.
Open your mouth slowly, only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for a moment, then close slowly.
Jaw_Open_Release.hands: Rest your hands in your lap, or fingertips lightly on your jaw.
Jaw_Open_Release.back: Sit tall with your head level, chin not poking forward.
Jaw_Open_Release.mistake: Opening too wide or letting your jaw slide to one side.

steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tip your right ear toward your right shoulder.
For more stretch, rest your right hand lightly on your head.
Hold, then come back up slowly and switch sides.
Side_Neck_Stretch.hands: Use only the weight of your hand. Do not pull hard.
Side_Neck_Stretch.arms: Let the other arm hang down to keep that shoulder low.
Side_Neck_Stretch.back: Sit or stand tall; do not lean your body.
Side_Neck_Stretch.breathe: Breathe slowly and let your shoulder sink.
Side_Neck_Stretch.mistake: Lifting your shoulder up toward your ear.

steps: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Lift your right knee, then put the foot down.
Lift your left knee, then put it down.
Swing your arms and keep a steady pace.
March_In_Place.arms: Swing your arms gently, elbows bent, like walking.
March_In_Place.legs: Lift your knees to a comfy height, land softly.
March_In_Place.back: Stand tall with your chest up.
March_In_Place.breathe: Breathe easily. You should be able to talk.
March_In_Place.mistake: Slouching and looking down at your feet.

steps: Stand tall and lift your arms straight out to the sides.
Make small circles with your arms.
Slowly make the circles a bit bigger.
Switch and circle the other way.
Arm_Circles.arms: Arms straight and level with your shoulders.
Arm_Circles.back: Stand tall; keep your shoulders down.
Arm_Circles.mistake: Shrugging your shoulders up as your arms get tired.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand.
Lift the dumbbells to head height, elbows bent.
Push them straight up over your head.
Lower them slowly back to head height.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.hands: Palms face forward, wrists straight over your elbows.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbows start bent at about a right angle.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.legs: Knees soft; do not bounce with your legs.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.back: Stand tall; squeeze your belly so you do not lean back.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you press, in as you lower.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press.mistake: Leaning back and arching your lower back.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your head and shoulders a little off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Come back to the middle, then reach for your left heel.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.hands: Reach your fingertips toward your heels.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.arms: Arms straight by your sides, just off the floor.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.legs: Feet flat and a bit wider than your hips.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.back: Lower back stays on the floor.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.breathe: Breathe out as you reach to each side.
Alternate_Heel_Touchers.mistake: Pulling your chin into your chest.

steps: Sit tall and let your shoulders drop.
Breathe in through your nose for a count of 4.
Hold your breath for 4.
Breathe out slowly for 4.
Hold empty for 4, then start again.
Breath_Box.hands: Rest your hands on your thighs or belly.
Breath_Box.breathe: Count slowly. Make each side of the box even.
Breath_Box.mistake: Tensing your shoulders during the holds.

steps: Stand with your feet a bit wider than your hips.
Put your hands on your hips and soften your knees.
Slowly draw big circles with your hips, like a hula hoop.
Go one way a few times, then the other way.
Gentle_Hip_Circles.back: Upper body stays fairly still while your hips move.
Gentle_Hip_Circles.mistake: Moving too fast. Keep it slow and smooth.

steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your left knee and let it fall across to the right.
Rest your right hand on your left knee.
Stretch your left arm out and look to the left. Hold.
Come back slowly and switch sides.
Knee_Across_The_Body.hands: Let your hand rest on your knee. Do not push it down.
Knee_Across_The_Body.arms: Free arm stretches out to the side, palm down.
Knee_Across_The_Body.legs: Bottom leg straight; top knee only goes as low as is comfy.
Knee_Across_The_Body.back: Both shoulders stay on the floor as much as you can.
Knee_Across_The_Body.breathe: Breathe slowly and relax a little more each breath out.
Knee_Across_The_Body.mistake: Forcing the knee to the floor.

steps: Lie on your back.
Bring both knees up toward your chest.
Hold under your knees with your arms.
Gently pull your knees closer and hold.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest.hands: Hold behind your thighs, just under your knees.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest.arms: Arms hold your knees gently; do not yank.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest.back: Let your lower back relax into the floor.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest.breathe: Breathe slowly and let your belly move.
Hug_Knees_To_Chest.mistake: Holding on top of your knees, which presses on the joints.

steps: Kneel on a mat, then step your right foot forward.
Your left knee and the top of your left foot rest on the floor.
Tuck your bottom under a little.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in your left hip.
Hold, then switch sides.
Kneeling_Hip_Flexor.hands: Hands on your front knee or on your hips.
Kneeling_Hip_Flexor.legs: Front knee over your ankle; back knee on a soft mat.
Kneeling_Hip_Flexor.back: Stay tall; do not arch your lower back.
Kneeling_Hip_Flexor.mistake: Leaning back and arching instead of tucking your bottom under.

steps: Sit tall and keep your head still.
Look up, then slowly roll your eyes right, down and left.
Make a few slow circles.
Switch and circle the other way, then blink and rest.
Eye_Circles.back: Sit tall with your head level and still.
Eye_Circles.breathe: Breathe slowly and keep your face relaxed.
Eye_Circles.mistake: Moving your head instead of just your eyes.

steps: Sit tall near the front of your chair, feet flat.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, like a number 4.
Keep your back straight and lean forward a little.
Hold where you feel a stretch, then switch legs.
Desk_Figure_Four.hands: Rest your hands on your shin and the raised knee.
Desk_Figure_Four.legs: Bottom foot flat; top ankle rests just past the knee.
Desk_Figure_Four.back: Lean forward from your hips with a straight back.
Desk_Figure_Four.breathe: Breathe slowly and relax into the stretch.
Desk_Figure_Four.mistake: Rounding your back to lean further forward.

steps: Sit tall in your chair, feet flat.
Hold the sides of the seat.
Straighten your right leg until it is level with the seat.
Hold for a moment, then lower it slowly.
Switch legs.
Desk_Seated_Leg_Raise.hands: Hold the sides of the seat.
Desk_Seated_Leg_Raise.legs: Lift the leg until straight; toes point up.
Desk_Seated_Leg_Raise.back: Sit tall; do not lean back.
Desk_Seated_Leg_Raise.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Desk_Seated_Leg_Raise.mistake: Leaning back and swinging the leg up.

steps: Lie on an incline bench with the bar above your eyes.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off.
Lower it slowly to your upper chest.
Push it back up until your arms are straight.
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.arms: Elbows angle down a little, not flared straight out.
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.back: Shoulder blades pinched together; head and bottom on the bench.
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Barbell_Incline_Bench_Press_-_Medium_Gri.mistake: Bouncing the bar off your chest.

steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower your shoulders slowly.
Barbell_Shrug.hands: Palms face you, hands a bit wider than shoulders.
Barbell_Shrug.arms: Arms stay straight; do not bend your elbows.
Barbell_Shrug.back: Stand tall; do not roll your shoulders.
Barbell_Shrug.breathe: Breathe out as you lift, in as you lower.
Barbell_Shrug.mistake: Bending your arms to help lift the bar.

steps: Hold one rope end in each hand, standing in a half squat.
Lift one arm up quickly to make a wave.
As it drops, lift the other arm.
Keep the waves going fast for the time set.
Battling_Ropes.hands: Grip the rope ends firmly, palms facing each other.
Battling_Ropes.arms: Arms move fast from the shoulders, elbows slightly bent.
Battling_Ropes.back: Chest up, back straight, slight lean forward.
Battling_Ropes.mistake: Standing up straight and using only your arms.

steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees a little and lean forward from your hips.
Let the dumbbells hang below your shoulders.
Pull them up to your ribs, then lower slowly.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.hands: Palms face each other, wrists straight.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.arms: Elbows stay close to your body as you pull.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.back: Back flat, nearly level with the floor.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.breathe: Breathe out as you pull, in as you lower.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.mistake: Rounding your back or standing up as you pull.

steps: Set your seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom.
Start pedaling at an easy pace.
Pick a pace you can keep for the time set.
Slow down for the last few minutes.
Bicycling.hands: Hold the handlebars lightly, wrists straight.
Bicycling.legs: Knees point forward; leg almost straight at the bottom.
Bicycling.back: Keep your back long, not hunched.
Bicycling.breathe: Breathe steadily. You should be able to talk a little.
Bicycling.mistake: Seat too low, so your knees bend too much.

steps: Set the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom.
Start pedaling easily to warm up.
Raise the resistance or speed to a pace you can hold.
Ease off for the last few minutes.
Bicycling_Stationary.legs: Knees point forward over your feet.

steps: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Hold the handles out to your sides at chest height.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest.
Let them open slowly back out.
Butterfly.hands: Hold the handles lightly, wrists straight.
Butterfly.arms: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Butterfly.breathe: Breathe out as you bring your arms together.
Butterfly.mistake: Letting your arms swing too far back.

steps: Kneel below a high cable holding a rope.
Hold the rope beside your head.
Curl your body down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Uncurl slowly back up.
Cable_Crunch.hands: Hold the rope ends beside your ears.
Cable_Crunch.arms: Arms stay still; your belly does the work.
Cable_Crunch.legs: Knees on a mat, hip-width apart.
Cable_Crunch.back: Round your back as you curl; keep hips still.
Cable_Crunch.breathe: Breathe out as you curl down.
Cable_Crunch.mistake: Sitting back with your hips instead of curling your belly.

steps: Stand facing a low cable with a rope attached.
Hold the rope with palms facing each other.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly.
Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment.hands: Palms face each other, wrists straight.
Cable_Hammer_Curls_-_Rope_Attachment.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.

steps: Attach a cuff to the ankle nearest a low cable.
Stand side-on and hold the machine for balance.
Pull that leg across in front of your other leg.
Let it return slowly.
Switch legs.
Cable_Hip_Adduction.legs: Standing knee soft; working leg stays fairly straight.
Cable_Hip_Adduction.breathe: Breathe out as you pull across.
Cable_Hip_Adduction.mistake: Leaning your body to swing the leg.

steps: Set two cables above head height.
Cross your arms and hold each cable with the opposite hand.
Pull your arms back and out wide.
Return slowly.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.hands: Hold the cables with a light grip.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.arms: Arms nearly straight with a soft elbow.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.back: Stand tall; do not lean back.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.breathe: Breathe out as you pull apart.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly.mistake: Using too much weight and shrugging.

steps: Face away from a cable, holding a rope behind your head.
Step forward and lean a little.
Straighten your arms forward and up over your head.
Bend your elbows slowly to bring it back.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.hands: Hold the rope ends, palms facing each other.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.arms: Elbows point forward and stay close to your head.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.legs: One foot in front of the other.
Cable_Rope_Overhead_Triceps_Extension.breathe: Breathe out as you straighten your arms.

steps: Sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Straighten your legs to lift the weight a little.
Push through your toes to press the platform away.
Let your heels come back slowly.
Calf_Press.legs: Knees nearly straight; only your ankles move.
Calf_Press.mistake: Bending your knees to help push.

steps: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the bottom edge.
Straighten your legs, knees soft.
Push through your toes to move the platform.
Let your heels come back slowly for a stretch.
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.hands: Hold the handles; keep the safety catches ready.
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.legs: Knees stay straight but not locked.
Calf_Press_On_The_Leg_Press_Machine.mistake: Letting your feet slip off the platform.

steps: Lie on a flat bench under the bar.
Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest.
Push it back up until your arms are straight.
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.arms: Elbows stay close to your sides.
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.back: Head, back and bottom stay on the bench.
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Close-Grip_Barbell_Bench_Press.mistake: Gripping so narrow that your wrists bend.

steps: Sit at the pulldown with your thighs under the pad.
Grip the bar with hands close together.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.hands: Hands close together, palms facing forward.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.arms: Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.legs: Thighs under the pad, feet flat.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.breathe: Breathe out as you pull down.
Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown.mistake: Swinging your body to pull the weight.

steps: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest that elbow on the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly. Switch arms after your set.
Concentration_Curls.arms: Upper arm stays pressed against your thigh.
Concentration_Curls.legs: Feet wide apart, flat on the floor.
Concentration_Curls.back: Lean forward a little with a straight back.
Concentration_Curls.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.
Concentration_Curls.mistake: Lifting your elbow off your thigh.

steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Put your hands lightly beside your head or across your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders up off the floor.
Lower back down slowly.
Crunches.hands: Fingertips lightly touch your head. Do not pull.
Crunches.arms: Elbows point out to the sides.
Crunches.back: Lower back stays on the floor.
Crunches.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.
Crunches.mistake: Pulling on your neck with your hands.

steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked in.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and lift it off.
Lower it slowly to your lower chest.
Push it back up.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.hands: Grip just wider than your shoulders, wrists straight.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.arms: Elbows angle down, not straight out.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.back: Back and head stay on the bench.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press.mistake: Lowering the bar too high toward your neck.

steps: Lie on a decline bench with your legs hooked in.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them slowly to the sides of your lower chest.
Push them back up.
Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.hands: Palms face your feet, wrists straight.
Decline_Dumbbell_Bench_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Put your feet up on a bench or step.
Place your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up.
Decline_Push-Up.hands: Hands a bit wider than your shoulders, fingers forward.
Decline_Push-Up.arms: Elbows bend back at an angle.
Decline_Push-Up.legs: Legs straight, toes on the bench.
Decline_Push-Up.back: Body in one straight line; hips do not sag.
Decline_Push-Up.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Hold the dip bars and lift yourself up, arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Bend your elbows to lower your body.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.hands: Grip the bars firmly, wrists straight.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.arms: Elbows point back and stay close to your body.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.legs: Legs hang down or cross at the ankles.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.back: Stay upright; do not lean far forward.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Dips_-_Triceps_Version.mistake: Going too low so your shoulders hurt.

steps: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly.
Open your arms out wide in a big arc.
Bring them back together over your chest.
Dumbbell_Flyes.arms: Keep the same soft bend in your elbows.
Dumbbell_Flyes.back: Back and head on the bench.
Dumbbell_Flyes.breathe: Breathe in as you open, out as you close.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly.
Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand.
Put your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the dumbbell.
Come back up to standing. Switch sides after your set.
Dumbbell_Side_Bend.hands: Hold the dumbbell at your side, palm facing in.
Dumbbell_Side_Bend.back: Bend straight to the side, not forward.
Dumbbell_Side_Bend.breathe: Breathe in as you bend, out as you rise.

steps: Stand tall holding an EZ bar on the angled grips.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly.
EZ-Bar_Curl.hands: Hold the angled part of the bar, palms up.
EZ-Bar_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.
EZ-Bar_Curl.mistake: Rocking your body to lift the bar.

steps: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar over your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Stop just above your head.
Straighten your arms to push it back up.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.hands: Hold the angled grips, wrists straight.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.arms: Upper arms point up and stay still.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.back: Back and head on the bench.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
EZ-Bar_Skullcrusher.mistake: Letting your elbows drift out wide.

steps: Stand facing away from a low cable, handle in one hand.
Start with the handle in front of your thigh.
Lift your arm straight in front to shoulder height.
Lower slowly. Switch arms after your set.
Front_Cable_Raise.hands: Palm faces down at the top.
Front_Cable_Raise.arms: Arm almost straight with a soft elbow.

steps: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Lift one or both arms straight in front of you.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Front_Dumbbell_Raise.mistake: Swinging your body to lift the weights.

steps: Stand in the machine with your back on the pad.
Put your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and bend your knees to lower down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Hack_Squat.hands: Hold the handles by your shoulders.
Hack_Squat.back: Back stays flat against the pad.
Hack_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Hack_Squat.mistake: Letting your heels lift off the platform.

steps: Lie face down on the back extension bench, ankles under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Bend forward slowly at your hips.
Lift back up until your body is straight.
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.legs: Legs straight, ankles locked under the pads.
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.back: Back straight; stop when your body forms a line.
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.breathe: Breathe in as you go down, out as you lift.
Hyperextensions_Back_Extensions.mistake: Arching too far back at the top.

steps: Stand tall, then bend over and put your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a push-up position.
Walk your feet in toward your hands.
Repeat, moving forward.
Inchworm.hands: Hands flat on the floor, small steps.
Inchworm.legs: Keep your legs as straight as is comfy; bend knees if needed.
Inchworm.back: In the push-up position, keep your back flat.
Inchworm.mistake: Letting your hips sag in the push-up position.

steps: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.back: Back and head against the bench.
Incline_Dumbbell_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.

steps: Set a bar at about waist height.
Lie under it and grab it a bit wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up to the bar, then lower slowly.
Inverted_Row.hands: Grip a little wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Inverted_Row.arms: Pull your elbows back toward your sides.
Inverted_Row.legs: Legs straight; bend your knees to make it easier.
Inverted_Row.back: Body stays straight like a plank.
Inverted_Row.breathe: Breathe out as you pull up.

steps: Rest your forearms on the pads with your back against the back pad.
Let your legs hang down.
Lift your knees up toward your chest.
Lower them slowly.
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.arms: Forearms rest on the pads, elbows bent.
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.legs: Bend your knees as you lift them.
Knee_Hip_Raise_On_Parallel_Bars.back: Lower back stays pressed into the pad.

steps: Sit in the machine with the handles at chest height.
Grip the handles.
Push forward until your arms are almost straight.
Let the handles come back slowly.
Leverage_Chest_Press.hands: Wrists straight, in line with your forearms.
Leverage_Chest_Press.arms: Elbows a little below your shoulders.
Leverage_Chest_Press.mistake: Locking your elbows hard at the end.

steps: Sit in the machine with the handles at shoulder height.
Grip the handles.
Push them up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them slowly.
Leverage_Shoulder_Press.back: Back against the pad; do not arch.
Leverage_Shoulder_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.
Leverage_Shoulder_Press.mistake: Arching your back off the pad.

steps: Sit in the machine with the handles at chest height.
Hold the handles.
Push forward until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.
Sit at the machine with your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the handles.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Machine_Preacher_Curls.arms: Upper arms stay flat on the pad.
Machine_Preacher_Curls.mistake: Lifting your elbows off the pad.

steps: Sit in the machine with the handles at shoulder height.
Grip the handles.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly.
Machine_Shoulder_Military_Press.arms: Elbows start just below the handles.

steps: Put a band around your ankles and one around your knees.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
Take short steps forward, left and right.
Then walk backward to where you started.
Monster_Walk.hands: Hands on hips or in front of you.
Monster_Walk.legs: Keep tension on the bands; knees push out.
Monster_Walk.back: Stay tall with a slight forward lean.

steps: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest.
Push your arms straight out in front.
Hold, then bring the handle back to your chest.
Pallof_Press.hands: Both hands wrapped around the handle.
Pallof_Press.arms: Push straight forward, do not let them drift.
Pallof_Press.legs: Feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent.
Pallof_Press.back: Do not let the cable twist your body.
Pallof_Press.breathe: Breathe out as you press out.
Pallof_Press.mistake: Letting your body turn toward the cable.

steps: Kneel by a bench and rest your forearms on it.
Hold a light barbell, palms up, wrists over the edge.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.hands: Palms face up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.arms: Forearms stay flat on the bench.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.back: Lean over the bench with a flat back.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.
Palms-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl_Over_A_Bench.mistake: Lifting your forearms off the bench.

steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands, arms hanging down.
Stand with feet wide and toes pointing out.
Bend your knees and lower until your thighs are level.
Push up through your heels.
Plie_Dumbbell_Squat.hands: Hold the top end of the dumbbell with both hands.
Plie_Dumbbell_Squat.legs: Knees push out in line with your toes.
Plie_Dumbbell_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.

steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up hard so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Plyo_Push-up.hands: Hands under your shoulders, landing in the same spot.
Plyo_Push-up.arms: Land with soft elbows, not locked arms.
Plyo_Push-up.legs: Legs straight; or knees down to make it easier.
Plyo_Push-up.breathe: Breathe out as you push up.

steps: Face away from a low cable, holding the rope between your legs.
Walk forward and stand with feet wide.
Push your hips back and let the rope pull through your legs.
Squeeze your bottom and stand up tall.
Pull_Through.hands: Hold the rope with both hands between your legs.
Pull_Through.arms: Arms stay straight; they do not pull.
Pull_Through.back: Back stays flat as you hinge.
Pull_Through.breathe: Breathe out as you stand up.
Pull_Through.mistake: Pulling with your arms instead of your hips.

steps: Start in a push-up position, hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up.
Push-Up_Wide.hands: Hands much wider than your shoulders, fingers forward.
Push-Up_Wide.arms: Elbows bend out to the sides at an angle.
Push-Up_Wide.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.

steps: Stand tall holding a barbell, palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly.
Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift your legs so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, bringing knees to your chest.
Lower your hips slowly.
Reverse_Crunch.arms: Arms stay still on the floor.
Reverse_Crunch.back: Upper back stays on the floor.
Reverse_Crunch.breathe: Breathe out as you curl your hips.
Reverse_Crunch.mistake: Swinging your legs instead of curling.

steps: Sit facing the pec deck with your chest on the pad.
Hold the handles in front of you, arms straight.
Pull your arms back and out to the sides.
Return slowly.
Reverse_Machine_Flyes.hands: Palms face each other or down, light grip.
Reverse_Machine_Flyes.arms: Arms almost straight with soft elbows.
Reverse_Machine_Flyes.breathe: Breathe out as you pull back.

steps: Start the treadmill at a walk to warm up.
Speed up to an easy run.
Run at a pace you can keep for the time set.
Slow to a walk for the last few minutes.
Running_Treadmill.arms: Elbows bent, swing your arms forward and back.
Running_Treadmill.legs: Land softly under your body, short quick steps.
Running_Treadmill.back: Run tall; look ahead, not down.

steps: Hang from a pull-up bar, arms straight.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Your body lifts a little without bending your arms.
Pause, then let your shoulders rise slowly.
Scapular_Pull-Up.hands: Palms face away, about shoulder-width apart.
Scapular_Pull-Up.arms: Arms stay straight the whole time.
Scapular_Pull-Up.back: Chest lifts slightly as shoulders go down.
Scapular_Pull-Up.breathe: Breathe out as you pull your shoulders down.
Scapular_Pull-Up.mistake: Bending your elbows to pull up.

steps: Sit on a bench with back support, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Turn your palms to face forward.
Push the dumbbells straight up.
Lower them slowly to shoulder height.
Seated_Dumbbell_Press.hands: Palms forward, wrists straight over elbows.
Seated_Dumbbell_Press.arms: Elbows a little in front of your body.
Seated_Dumbbell_Press.back: Back against the pad; do not arch.
Seated_Dumbbell_Press.mistake: Arching your back off the bench.

steps: Sit in the machine with the pad behind your lower legs.
Lower the thigh pad onto your legs.
Pull your heels down and back under the seat.
Let your legs straighten slowly.
Seated_Leg_Curl.legs: Knees line up with the machine's pivot.

steps: Sit on a bench holding a light barbell, palms up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists past your knees.
Let the bar roll down toward your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can.
Seated_Palm-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl.hands: Palms face up, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Seated_Palm-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl.arms: Forearms stay flat on your thighs.
Seated_Palm-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl.back: Lean forward a little with a flat back.
Seated_Palm-Up_Barbell_Wrist_Curl.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.

steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet or stagger them.
Lift your hips so your body is a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.
Side_Bridge.hands: Bottom hand flat on the floor; top hand on your hip.
Side_Bridge.arms: Bottom elbow right under your shoulder.
Side_Bridge.legs: Legs straight; bend the bottom knee to make it easier.
Side_Bridge.back: Head, hips and feet in one line.
Side_Bridge.mistake: Letting your hips sag toward the floor.

steps: Stand in front of a high box with a band or rope to hold.
Step onto the box with one foot.
Stand up fully, letting the other leg hang.
Step down slowly. Do all reps, then switch legs.
Single-Leg_High_Box_Squat.hands: Hold the band or rope for balance.
Single-Leg_High_Box_Squat.breathe: Breathe out as you step up.
Single-Leg_High_Box_Squat.mistake: Pushing off the floor with the back foot.

steps: Lie on a bench under the Smith machine bar.
Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders and unhook it.
Lower it slowly to your mid-chest.
Push it back up and re-hook when done.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.hands: Grip just wider than shoulders, wrists straight.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.arms: Elbows angle down, not flared wide.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.back: Head, back and bottom on the bench.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you push.
Smith_Machine_Bench_Press.mistake: Setting the bench so the bar lands on your neck.

steps: Stand under the Smith bar with it across your upper back.
Feet shoulder-width apart, slightly in front of the bar.
Unhook the bar and sit your hips down.
Push up through your feet.
Smith_Machine_Squat.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Smith_Machine_Squat.legs: Knees follow your toes; heels stay down.
Smith_Machine_Squat.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.
Smith_Machine_Squat.mistake: Feet too far under the bar, so knees shoot forward.

steps: Stand holding the Smith bar at your thighs.
Soften your knees a little.
Push your hips back and lower the bar down your legs.
Stand back up by pushing your hips forward.
Smith_Machine_Stiff-Legged_Deadlift.hands: Grip just wider than your hips, palms facing you.
Smith_Machine_Stiff-Legged_Deadlift.legs: Knees slightly bent and stay that way.
Smith_Machine_Stiff-Legged_Deadlift.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
Smith_Machine_Stiff-Legged_Deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back at the bottom.

steps: Put the Smith bar across your upper back.
Rest your back foot on a bench behind you.
Bend your front knee to lower straight down.
Push up through your front heel. Switch legs after your set.
Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.hands: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you rise.
Smith_Single-Leg_Split_Squat.mistake: Front foot too close to the bench.

steps: Lie chest-down on the angled side of a preacher bench.
Let your arms hang straight down holding the bar.
Curl the bar up toward your face.
Lower it slowly.
Spider_Curl.arms: Upper arms hang straight down and stay still.
Spider_Curl.legs: Feet on the floor for support.

steps: Stand on the middle of a band, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band ends at your shoulders.
Sit your hips down into a squat.
Push up through your feet.
Squats_-_With_Bands.hands: Hold the band at shoulder height, palms forward.
Squats_-_With_Bands.breathe: Breathe in going down, out coming up.

steps: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar.
Hold the bar, palms up, elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Lower it slowly.
Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl.arms: Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
Standing_Biceps_Cable_Curl.mistake: Leaning back to pull the weight.

steps: Stand side-on to a high cable, holding the handle with both hands.
Pull the handle down and across your body to the opposite knee.
Turn your shoulders and hips as you pull.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.legs: Feet shoulder-width apart; pivot your back foot.
Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.back: Keep your back long as you twist.
Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.breathe: Breathe out as you chop down.
Standing_Cable_Wood_Chop.mistake: Pulling only with your arms instead of turning.

steps: Stand tall and lift a dumbbell over your head in one hand.
Bend your elbow to lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arm to lift it back up.
Switch arms after your set.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens.hands: Palm faces forward or in, wrist straight.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens.arms: Elbow points up and stays near your head.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens.breathe: Breathe in as you lower, out as you lift.
Standing_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extens.mistake: Letting your elbow drift out to the side.

steps: Stand facing a high cable and hold the bar.
Step back and lean forward a little, arms straight.
Push the bar down to your thighs in an arc.
Let it rise slowly to head height.
Straight-Arm_Pulldown.arms: Arms stay straight with a soft elbow.
Straight-Arm_Pulldown.breathe: Breathe out as you push down.
Straight-Arm_Pulldown.mistake: Bending your elbows like a pushdown.

steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly.
Superman.hands: Palms face down or toward each other.
Superman.legs: Legs straight, lifting from your hips.
Superman.back: Lift gently; look at the floor to keep your neck long.

steps: Stand inside a trap bar, feet hip-width apart.
Bend down and grab the handles.
Flatten your back and lift your chest.
Push through your feet to stand up tall.
Lower the bar the same way.
Trap_Bar_Deadlift.hands: Grip the middle of each handle.
Trap_Bar_Deadlift.legs: Knees bend more than a regular deadlift.
Trap_Bar_Deadlift.breathe: Take a big breath in before you lift.
Trap_Bar_Deadlift.mistake: Rounding your back at the start.

steps: Lean forward with one hand and knee on a bench.
Hold a dumbbell with your elbow bent at your side.
Straighten your arm back.
Bend it slowly back down. Switch arms after your set.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.arms: Upper arm stays still, level with your body.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.breathe: Breathe out as you straighten your arm.
Tricep_Dumbbell_Kickback.mistake: Swinging the weight instead of keeping the elbow still.

steps: Face away from a cable, holding a rope behind your head.
Step forward into a split stance.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Bend your elbows slowly to return.
Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope.hands: Hold the rope ends, palms facing each other.
Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope.arms: Elbows stay close to your head.
Triceps_Overhead_Extension_with_Rope.legs: One foot in front for balance.

steps: Stand facing a high cable with a rope attached.
Hold the rope with elbows tucked at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly to chest height.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.hands: Palms face each other, thumbs up.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.arms: Upper arms stay still; only forearms move.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.back: Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Triceps_Pushdown_-_Rope_Attachment.breathe: Breathe out as you push down.

steps: Stand tall holding a barbell in front of your thighs.
Pull the bar straight up close to your body.
Stop at about chest height.
Lower it slowly.
Upright_Barbell_Row.hands: Palms face you, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Upright_Barbell_Row.arms: Elbows lead and stay higher than your hands.
Upright_Barbell_Row.mistake: Pulling the bar too high if it pinches your shoulders.

steps: Step on and start the treadmill slowly.
Speed up to a brisk walk.
Raise the incline a little if you want it harder.
Slow down for the last few minutes.
Walking_Treadmill.legs: Step heel to toe at a brisk pace.
Walking_Treadmill.breathe: Breathe steadily. You should be able to talk.

steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a weight on your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Weighted_Crunches.hands: Hold the weight against your chest.
Weighted_Crunches.arms: Arms wrap the weight close to you.
Weighted_Crunches.back: Lower back stays on the floor.
Weighted_Crunches.breathe: Breathe out as you curl up.

steps: Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back.
Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up.
wg_weighted-push-up.hands: Hands under your shoulders, a bit wider.
